scope: Four source/target stills per clip at 0,60,120,180 seconds. Supplemented by short source/target replay exports at +60 seconds in each show middle clip. Not exhaustive full-video inspection; no human model approval.
admission: Weak observed stage appearance only, not clean lighting labels. Geometry failures and unknown color use masks; exposure/occlusions/LED content can remain. Missingness depends on scene brightness.
